purpose: Semantic content-anchor layer applied after routing/profile rules and before prompt compilation. It may strengthen subject/environment and append concrete recognition/must/avoid cues, but it is forbidden from changing archetype, visual_variant, or art_category. Created after the 100-card bulk validation showed generic title-only recipes were not sufficient.

patch.subject_template: Make the exact named food or dish ${title} the dominant edible subject, shown close enough that its characteristic form, ingredients, texture, serving vessel, and preparation style are visually identifiable; include a human hand serving, preparing, sharing, or eating it
patch.environment_template: A close kitchen, dining table, serving counter, or home-food setting that supports ${title}; the food occupies the visual center and the venue remains secondary and text-free
recognition_anchors_add: the exact named ${title} food itself dominates the frame
dish-specific shape, ingredients, texture, vessel, or preparation method
human serving/preparing/eating interaction
must_include_add: the exact named ${title} food, not a substitute dish
at least two visually specific food cues appropriate to ${title}
avoid_add: generic pasta, sandwich, pizza, soup, pastry, or unrelated cuisine substituted for ${title}
camera, phone, controller, computer, or unrelated gadget as focal object
menu text, package text, restaurant signage, labels

recognition_anchors_add: real food and serving dishes dominate over venue décor
hands actively serving, selecting, sharing, or tasting
must_include_add: at least one clearly visible food serving/preparation cue
avoid_add: readable menus, signs, lantern text, banners, price tags
camera or electronic gadget as focal object

recognition_anchors_add: drink vessel plus pouring, brewing, steeping, mixing, tasting, or serving action
ingredients or tools physically associated with the named drink ritual
must_include_add: one real beverage vessel
one physical preparation or tasting action
avoid_add: laptop, monitor, phone, camera, controller, code screen, digital dashboard
readable bottle/cafe labels or menu text
